finding.description: Bok authorization invocationPreimage omits parent/root/kind/reference fields although postArgs contains canonical reply context. Helper defaults parent/root0, kind1, reference0. Any reply with nonzero parent/root authorizes a different immutable target than Board post_with_bok derives from full draft. Escrow on_invocation must reject mismatched target.
evidence: invocation.mjs25-35 preimage positions6/7 include parent/root with zero defaults.
Board main.nr1058 computes full-draft target and calls escrow; escrow on_invocation asserts exact authorized equality.
Existing reply unit test1405 checks canonical args and sends using doubles, but does not compare full-draft target to original authorization.
finding.observedFailureAttribution: Controls actual prepare simulations generic SDK Assertion failed have not yet exposed a verified location. Source target mismatch is certain for nonzero reply fields, but exact failure stage requires original saved-draft comparison or safe SDK mapping.
finding.smallestCheck: Within existing wallet owner session, recompute original-call and full-draft preimages/hashes from saved authorized record. Report target equality booleans and changed public field names only; no model/wallet send or fresh request.
finding.repair: Authorize using every immutable post field and assert complete target binding before preparation/submission; regression must compare actual full-draft hash across original authorization/reopen/post.
finding.recovery: Original confirmed authorization cannot be amended. If original stored target mismatches intended draft, preserve it and use existing explicitly reviewed owned release/cancel, then a fresh correctly bound request only when lead dispatches. Never rerun original authorization.
